### Finding God’s Goodness In Creation
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-march-4-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 24:1-2
Points:
- The entire earth and everything living within it belongs solely to the Lord.
- God purposefully established creation according to His divine design and wisdom.
- Human attempts to critique or second-guess God's creative order are foolish.
- Believers should praise God and honor Him for the works of His hands.

### Why “the Earth Is the Lord's” Should Comfort and Convict Us
Author: Betty Dunn
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/why-the-earth-is-the-lords-should-comfort-and-convict-us.html
Passage: Psalm 24:1
Points:
- God reigns supreme as the true Creator, Ruler, and Sustainer of the world and all people.
- Human beings are temporary tenants tasked with responsible stewardship rather than selfish ownership.
- Material greed leads humanity to abuse nature instead of honoring God's design.
- Resting in God's absolute ownership brings deep peace and assurance amidst human weakness.
